pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Left leg, printed face towards you. Needs at least 4.5 V: use VIN

pins.name: OUT
pins.notes: Right leg. Open collector: use INPUT_PULLUP (to 3.3 V), never a pull-up to 5 V

sources.title: Allegro A3141/2/3/4 datasheet
sources.section: Pin 1 supply, 2 ground, 3 output (open collector); supply 4.5 to 24 V
